CREATE TABLE "public"."admin" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "username" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."analytics_rate_limit" (
  "count" int8 NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "window" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."backup_run" (
  "bytes" int8,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "dailyKey" text,
  "finishedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "sha256" text,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."category" (
  "color" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "nameKey" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."comment" (
  "adminId" int8,
  "author" text NOT NULL,
  "authorKind" text NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "parentId" text,
  "postId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "submissionHash" text,
  "submissionId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."comment_rate_limit" (
  "count" int8 NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "window" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."friend_link" (
  "avatar" text NOT NULL,
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "enabled" int8 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  "version" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."login_rate_limit" (
  "count" int8 NOT NULL,
  "id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "window" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."media" (
  "adminId" int8 NOT NULL,
  "bytes" int8,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "expectedBytes" int8 NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "height" int8,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "leaseToken" text,
  "leaseUntil" timestamptz,
  "mime" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "objectKey" text NOT NULL,
  "sha256" text NOT NULL,
  "stagingCleanedAt" timestamptz,
  "stagingKey" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "uploadedAt" timestamptz,
  "width" int8,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."media_upload_limit" (
  "adminId" int8 NOT NULL,
  "count" int8 NOT NULL,
  "window" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("adminId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notification" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "href" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "resolvedAt" timestamptz,
  "sourceId" text,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notification_read" (
  "adminId" int8 NOT NULL,
  "notificationId" text NOT NULL,
  "readAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("notificationId", "adminId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."operation_setting" (
  "autoBackup" int8 NOT NULL,
  "id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "schedulerLastRunAt" timestamptz,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."page_visit" (
  "article" int8 NOT NULL,
  "browser" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "device" text NOT NULL,
  "durationMs" int8 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ip" text NOT NULL,
  "lastSeenAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "location" text NOT NULL,
  "os" text NOT NULL,
  "path" text NOT NULL,
  "postId" text,
  "progress" int8 NOT NULL,
  "referrerHost" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionId" text NOT NULL,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  "visitorHash" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."post" (
  "categoryId" text NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "featuredOrder" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isFeatured" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "publishedAt" timestamptz,
  "scheduledFor" timestamptz,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "slugLockedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "summary" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."post_tag" (
  "postId" text NOT NULL,
  "tagId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("postId", "tagId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."release_log" (
  "changes" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "version" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "adminId" int8 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."site_setting" (
  "aboutMe" text NOT NULL,
  "authorName" text NOT NULL,
  "authorRole" text NOT NULL,
  "avatarUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "baiduEnabled" int8 NOT NULL,
  "baiduId" text NOT NULL,
  "enableComments" int8 NOT NULL,
  "googleEnabled" int8 NOT NULL,
  "googleId" text NOT NULL,
  "icpText" text NOT NULL,
  "icpUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "id" int8 NOT NULL,
  "localAnalyticsEnabled" int8,
  "localAnalyticsStartedAt" timestamptz,
  "policeText" text NOT NULL,
  "policeUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "postsPerPage" int8 NOT NULL,
  "subtitle" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."social_account" (
  "enabled" int8 NOT NULL,
  "icon" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "position" int8 NOT NULL,
  "settingId" int8 NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tag" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "nameKey" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."visit_session" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastSeenAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "visitorHash" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
